Ancestry Core (v1.1, RFI-native). Shared across all Qliph-Scarred heritages. Granted at character creation via the base ancestry item's ItemGrant advancement.

“You walked out of a place that should have unmade you. The hollows never closed. The world can feel the pressure leaking out.”

Qliph-Scarred Core Traits

  • Shadow Resilience. You resist qliphothic damage. Reroll-lowest on Body checks against drain, wither, and corruption effects.
  • Qliphothic Saturation. 1/scene, reroll a failed Soul check — but the scene's Darkness-gain count goes up by 1. The scar pays for what the scar saves.
  • Hunger Mask. You can suppress a bodily need (hunger, thirst, sleep, breath) for up to 24 hours by deciding to. After 24 hours, all deferred needs hit at once.
  • Shadow-Wake. Qliphothic-attuned creatures sense you at 60 ft and know you've been marked. They may not know how to read the mark.
⟁ Per-Use Ability — Qliphothic Saturation
Recovery: 1/scene  ·  Action: Free  ·  Use: Click this feature on your sheet to invoke.
